title: Text: DET Chad Crunk ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Hey Anthony, are you the only free press writer covering the Winter Meetings next week or will anyone else be coming?
What day is the HOF announcement? Wednesday of winter meetings?
Before the winter meetings start? I always thought they had a press conference there to announce
They have a press conference Monday morning will all the living electees
But the initial announcement is made on mlb network on Sunday night

For your planning purposes, there will be a HoF teleconference Sunday night with the electees and if tram is one of them we’re going to try and get you guys a few minutes with him on Sunday night as well
